title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ignition security update
description: A security vulnerability was identified in the Ignition utility used during system initialization in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8. The flaw involves the golang crypto/x509 package, which could allow man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates. This vulnerability affects the process by which Ignition reads and applies configuration from various sources on first boot. Red Hat has released an update to address this issue.
